_comment: Balatro hand-fan geometry, as fractions of the game canvas. Fitted by scripts/pov_calibrate.py; see docs/POV.md. 'raise' is NOT measured -- the API never highlights the fly's virtual selection. 'fixed_pitch' records a MEASURED fact (scripts/pov_align_measure.py, outputs/pov/dynamic_align.json): with fewer than 8 cards Balatro does NOT spread the fan, it keeps the same centre-to-centre pitch and centres the shorter fan. Two independent 3-card hands measure a pitch of 165-171 px against the 8-card 164.65 px.
